text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[Greymon] in name or w/[ME]/[VB] trait: Cost 3

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
＜Decode (Lv.4 or lower w/[Agumon]/[Greymon] in name or w/[ME]/[VB] trait)＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less. Then, give 1 of their Digimon "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks." until their turn ends.

text_sections.label: Special Play Condition
text_sections.text: Assembly -2: Lv.4 or lower w/[Agumon]/[Greymon] in name or w/[ME]/[VB] trait

text_sections.text: ＜Decode (Lv.4 or lower w/[Agumon]/[Greymon] in name or w/[ME]/[VB] trait)＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 specified Digimon card from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.)

extracted.name: MetalGreymon

qa.answer: You can give the effect, but if the Digimon isn't affected by effects at the time it would be triggered, it will not trigger.
qa.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to give "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks" to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?

qa.answer:
Yes, both have to be XX.
For example, "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait or that is yellow or black" means either "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait" or "1 level 4 or lower Digimon card that is yellow or black." In both cases, the card must be level 4 or lower.
qa.question: If a text says "XX card with AA or BB," does that mean AA and BB both have to be XX?
